🇳🇵 Nepal–Tibet Border Avalanche & Flood | 26 August 2026 A major ice–rock avalanche near the Nepal–Tibet border triggered a cascading hazard: a large glacier mass collapsed from high elevation, sending ice, rock and sediment into the Lhende Khola. The debris blocked the river and formed a temporary barrier lake, which then released a powerful downstream surge of muddy water, debris and boulders. 🌡️ Possible factors: glacier instability, melting ice, steep crevassed terrain, meltwater lubrication and possible seismic triggering. ⚠️ Some claims remain unconfirmed, so the exact trigger requires scientific investigation. 🌊 Avalanche → Debris Flow → River Blockage → Dam Breach → Flood #Nepal #NepalFlood #NepalLandslide #NepalAvalanche #NepalTibetBorder Himalayas HimalayanAvalanche Landslide GlacierCollapse GlacialLake BarrierLake FlashFlood DebrisFlow LhendeKhola Bhotekoshi ClimateChange GlacierMelt NaturalDisaster DisasterScience EarthScience 26August2026

A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives. Her silent expression says what words cannot—survival can come with an unimaginable cost. 💔🙏🇳🇵 #NepalFlood #NepalArmy #FloodRescue #Humanity #BetterFromNepal Follow BetterFromNepal for more such stories.

I usually don’t share these moments from when I travel for obvious reasons… I spent a month in Nepal last year, I was going on an evening walk and these little girls were following me asking for money. 🌊 Imágenes que ponen los pelos de punta. Este vídeo grabado en Nepal 🇳🇵 muestra un momento de enorme tensión: una persona se encuentra atrapada en una corriente de agua extremadamente fuerte mientras varias personas, desde la orilla, intentan acercarse y ayudarla. La fuerza del agua se aprecia perfectamente en las imágenes. Lo que desde lejos puede parecer simplemente un canal desbordado puede convertirse en cuestión de segundos en una situación tremendamente peligrosa. Y entonces ocurre algo que también merece ser destacado: varias personas se unen inmediatamente para intentar ayudar. 🤝 Unos sujetan a otros, se acercan todo lo posible al borde y tratan de alcanzar a la persona mientras la corriente continúa golpeando con enorme fuerza. En situaciones de inundaciones y crecidas repentinas, incluso una profundidad aparentemente pequeña puede resultar extremadamente peligrosa. El agua en movimiento tiene mucha más fuerza de la que solemos imaginar. Nepal ha sufrido recientemente graves inundaciones que han dejado imágenes realmente impactantes, pero antes de relacionar este vídeo con un episodio concreto sería necesario conocer su ubicación y fecha exactas. 🎥 Mira hasta el final. Momentos así recuerdan tanto la enorme fuerza de la naturaleza como lo que somos capaces de hacer cuando alguien necesita ayuda. 👇 ¿Tú qué habrías hecho en una situación así? #Nepal #Inundaciones #Rescate #Actualidad #Impactante

Journalist Bidhya Chapagain broke down in tears after witnessing the difficult living conditions of people in Ripa village of Humla, Karnali. Wildest Festival Yet 🤯🐮 Only in Nepal will you find a festival to do with people passing away, cows, dancing, cross dressing and loads more.  Welcome to Gai Jatra - which literally translates to cow festival.  There’s a huge historical story behind it which is too long to explain here but essentially people originally took cows through the street as a way of saying  final goodbye to their loved ones but now for practicality they use these giant effigies call Tahamacha.
